title: Tracing an interbank transfer through the ledger
name: Ledger transfer tracing

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code creates, propagates, or finishes trace spans? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Which span is the parent of ledger.post_journal, and what span ID does the ledger service receive in its traceparent header?
choices: transfer.reserve_funds is the parent; the ledger sees transfer.reserve_funds's ID
transfer.execute is the parent; the ledger sees transfer.execute's ID
There is no parent; the ledger receives a new root trace
transfer.execute is the parent; the ledger sees ledger.post_journal's ID

questions.prompt: store.reserve throws because the account has insufficient funds. Which spans end up with ERROR status?
choices: Neither, because the error is rethrown before status is set

questions.prompt: Why is the amount passed to the ledger as amountMinor.toString() rather than as the bigint itself?
choices: JSON.stringify throws a TypeError on bigint values, so it must be converted
The ledger API requires amounts in major units
Converting avoids floating-point rounding when the span attribute is recorded
toString() strips the currency so the ledger can apply its own
